query:
WITH pubs AS (
                   SELECT DISTINCT publisher AS name
                     FROM manifestations
                    WHERE publisher IS NOT NULL
               )
               SELECT name AS "name!"
                 FROM pubs
                WHERE name ILIKE $1 || '%' OR $2 <% name
                ORDER BY (name ILIKE $1 || '%') DESC,
                         word_similarity($2, name) DESC,
                         name ASC
                LIMIT $3
